states.description: The person is resting in bed before starting their morning routine.

next.on: The person visibly wakes and starts getting out of bed for the morning.

states.description: The person is getting out of bed and beginning the morning; they habitually drink milk with breakfast even when the other foods vary.

rules.trigger: The person is visibly awake and getting out of bed to start the morning, a routine followed by drinking milk with breakfast regardless of the other foods; the milk remains available in its usual storage area rather than already beside the person, and the person is not holding or touching it.
rules.action: Pick up the milk and place it next to the person.

next.on: The person starts eating or drinking at the breakfast table.

states.description: The person is actively eating or drinking breakfast, so the cup and plate are still in use.

next.on: The person visibly finishes breakfast and begins clearing meal items from the table.

states.description: Breakfast has ended and the person has cleared some items, while a used cup or plate may still remain on the table.

next.on: After finishing breakfast and clearing some meal items, the person is visibly observed leaving home through the exit.

states.description: The person has visibly left home after finishing breakfast and partially clearing the table; absence from the camera view alone does not establish departure or forgetfulness.

rules.trigger: Breakfast has visibly ended, the person has cleared some meal items and has been observed leaving home through the exit, and a used cup remains on the breakfast table rather than in the sink; the cup is not held or touched and is no longer being used.
rules.action: Pick up the cup and place it in the sink.

rules.trigger: Breakfast has visibly ended, the person has cleared some meal items and has been observed leaving home through the exit, and a used plate remains on the breakfast table rather than in the sink; the plate is not held or touched and is no longer being used.
rules.action: Pick up the plate and place it in the sink.
